record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:92 — Persisting attendees before updating the external calendar leaves the booking permanently out of sync when the calendar update fails, because a retry rejects those guests as already present.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in addGuests.handler.ts, the code first persists new attendees to the database via prisma.booking.update (lines 92-107), then later calls eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees (line 165). If the calendar update fails, the attendees are already in the database. On retry, the uniqueGuests filter (lines 70-74) will exclude these guests because they're already in booking.attendees, causing the retry to fail with 'emails_must_be_unique_valid'. This is a real consistency bug where database and calendar can get out of sync with no recovery path.
